notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
In this update we solved some major and minor bugs.
Thanks to all the posts on the Steam Community Hub who told us the bugs to fix!

Also we updated the images of the library.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30000776/e41e8abc74a749f85c53e7f7ab52d179fc7f992a.png[/img]

notes.title: -3 days to the official release!
notes.notes:
There is only 3 days left and finally [b]ZAP Master[/b] will arrive on [b]Steam[/b]!
On the day of release ([b]1st September[/b]), there will also be a discount, so, don't wait to take it!
